an6.89:1.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.89:1.3: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ, vicikicchaṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ mohaṃ.
an6.89:1.4: Ime kho bhikkhave cha dhamme appahāya abhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ. 3.
an6.89:2.1: Cha bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo diṭṭhisampadaṃ sacchikātuṃ.
an6.89:2.3: Sakkāyadiṭṭhiṃ, vicikicchaṃ, sīlabbataparāmāsaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ rāgaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ dosaṃ, apāyagamaniyaṃ mohaṃ.
